testCases.label: Test with positive integers resulting in a whole number average
testCases.description: Verifies that the average of the array {1, 3, 1, 3} is correctly calculated as 2.0.

testCases.label: Test with positive integers resulting in a decimal average
testCases.description: Verifies that the average of the array {1, 2} is correctly calculated as 1.5.

testCases.label: Test with a sequence of positive integers
testCases.description: Verifies that the average of the array {1, 2, 3} is correctly calculated as 2.0.

testCases.label: Test with mixed positive and negative integers resulting in zero average
testCases.description: Verifies that the average of the array {4, -4} is correctly calculated as 0.0.
